items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dig up Robichaux’s or Piron’s discography.

ctx.x: What were some of those songs? You mentioned Careless Love.

What Will Become of Joe?, My Baby’s Loving Arms, I’m Forever Blowing Bubbles. We have to get a repertoire. Dig up Robichaux’s or Piron’s discography. Wish I Could Shimmy Like My Sister Kate, Mamacita, Robert E. Lee. They played them plantation songs and riverboat songs, but the music business wasn’t aggressive in putting out new music then. The market was limited, because in those days they sold piano copies. You went and if a new song came out and they heard it on the way to . . . it wasn’t no talkies then . . .…
Did you see any of those type singers here, vaudeville singers?
